historical_comparators.name: ProviderSwitchReadiness

sufficient_existing_capabilities: caller-supplied exact canonical frames can execute through C03, Binder, Runtime, and ProviderExecutionEnvelope
canonical execution can use injected recording/fake providers without production response selection
conversation_id and turn_id are preserved end-to-end through package, bundle, envelope, and trace
gate receipt, semantic fingerprint, exact ordered units/messages, provider_id, and modality are observable
ProviderExecutionEnvelope.verify() and AdmittedSemanticBundle.verify() provide deterministic integrity checks
structured single-execution evidence fields can be modeled with immutable to_dict() payloads
output presence/status can be represented mechanically from exact execution success and nonempty response

missing_required_capabilities.reason: no immutable contract deterministically pairs one caller-supplied reference execution record with one canonical-shadow execution record under the same correlation identity
canonical conversation_id and turn_id are available end-to-end, but no comparator fails closed when reference and candidate identities differ
no evidence-only comparator records semantic fingerprint equality, unit/message order equality, provider/envelope identity, and output presence/status in one deterministic record
deterministic canonical digests exist, but there is no replay record proving the same paired inputs and comparison dimensions for repeated harness execution
historical evaluators generate scores, but their outputs are not mechanically bound to the paired canonical provenance and comparison record

deferred_missing_capabilities.reason: comparison evidence must never select production output
P4 requires bounded evidence only, not durable productionization

correlation_analysis.classification: Canonical identity fields are sufficient for deterministic pairing, but no reference/candidate carrier validates and preserves the relation as evidence.

p4_b_scope_gate.DOES_THIS_DIRECTLY_PREVENT_P4_B_COMPARIS: YES for the five missing evidence-only comparison capabilities listed above
p4_b_scope_gate.NO_GAP_DISPOSITION: All NO gaps remain explicitly deferred outside P4-B.

exact canonical PreparedCanonicalTurn or canonical execution record
optional injected recording/fake provider for deterministic canonical execution
optional structured evaluation fields supplied as evidence
outputs: one immutable deterministic paired comparison record
fingerprint, order, provider/envelope identity, and output/status dimension evidence
